description: This file defines the PdfFontDescriptor class, which represents font metrics and attributes for PDF fonts within the PDFsharp library. It includes flags for font characteristics, properties for font names, metrics, and methods for preparing font data for PDF output.

classes.name: PdfFontDescriptor
classes.description: A class representing font metrics and attributes in a PDF context, capable of preparing font data for inclusion in a PDF document.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: A nested class defining dictionary keys used within the PdfFontDescriptor class for PDF serialization.

methods.name: FlagsFromDescriptor
methods.description: Generates font characteristic flags based on the OpenTypeDescriptor.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the font descriptor for writing into a PDF file by creating and adding a font program.

methods.name: CreateEmbeddedFontSubsetName
methods.description: Generates a unique six-letter uppercase name for font subset embedding.
